objective_scoring: Exact comparison with unchanged MedQA answer_idx; no model judge

budget.policy: Before each paid request, reserve a conservative prompt-byte estimate plus the full output cap at configured provider price ceilings. Failed requests without usage retain that reserve. This is a local guard, not a provider billing guarantee.

limitations: Ten selected short test cases, three paired agent cases, one sample each; unequal native reasoning controls, provider routing, possible benchmark memorization, no clinical validation.
